title: 第3章 相爷公子第4章 寿元极限
slug: 苟住开局长生修仙只是副业
content_zh:
翌日！
林铭前往天牢，狱卒休息处，今天当值的雷校尉正领着文书们耍着钱！
林铭不耍钱，却也一样是在一旁看着热闹！
“大！”
“大！”
跟着他们一同在这里呼喊着。
不管能不能中，氛围肯定是要搞起来！
雷校尉今天手气不错，一连三把，都赢了钱，嘴角上扬，目光在全场扫视的时候，也注意到了自己身边的林铭！
“呦！林狱卒，练武了？！”
以前林铭就听说雷校尉在武道上造诣颇深，是个真气外放境界的高手！
现在才知道所言不虚！
要不然怎能一眼就看出他的虚实来？！
一听说林铭开始练武，周围的狱卒文书们也都显现出了意外之色。
张文书好心提醒着：
“林狱卒，这武道可不是谁都能修炼的！没有一定的钱粮，就是往里面扔那白花花的银子……有那钱财，不如多置两晌地，多取个媳妇，还能够给子孙后代多留些基业，未来九泉之下见到列祖列宗，也更有面子不是？！”
“对啊！林狱卒，我知道你喜欢听评书，喜欢听那些侠义的故事，那些故事，听听也就是了，可千万别因为那些故事，想要练武，跟着他们行侠仗义……先不说那些故事都是编的，就真有那些故事存在！”
陈管营也跟着赞同着。
“你现在根骨已成，想要修炼到那般的武道境界，不仅是要有上好的武功，还要有配套的炼体汤药，等等一些辅助之物，这其中哪一个都要海量的银子，武道，就是一个无底洞！白花花的银子扔进去，连个响都听不到！到最后，你时间耽误了，钱粮没了，武道修为还没上来，可就追悔莫及了！”
“诸位大人说得对！”
林铭连连点头，赞同着：

“这武道的困难，我也知道，我就是一个小人物，也不打算在武道上有什么太大的成就，就是自己修炼着玩玩，就算是达不到雷校尉这等实力，至少也是能够强身健体的，我们久居天牢，阴暗潮湿，身体容易遭病，练武起码能够强壮自身，延年益寿，就算是为此扔进去一些银钱，我认为也是值得的！”
“林狱卒说得对！武道修炼，重在强身健体，只要能够达成自己的目的即可！”
雷校尉也顺势说道：
“不是在武道上练不出成就，就不能习武的，不要那么强的功利心么？！”
雷校尉一开口，那就是盖棺定论！
不论其他人心中是不是还有其他想法，领头的都开口了，他们自然都是要顺着领导的口风说话！
“雷校尉所言极是，林狱卒，好好修炼，万一有所成就，也要带带我们？！”
“对，你练的是哪家功法？！我们一起？！”
“带我一个，带我一个，我也想要强身健体，增长寿元！”
面对这些声音，林铭保持微笑，连连点头。
“诸位大人同僚有心，小的自然愿意和各位一同练习，我所练的是从犯人身上拷问出来的功法，稀疏平常，哪位想要，我这就可以写出来，抄给大人一份！”
“有时间给我一份！”
“对，有时间给我一份！”
这些也就都只是口花而已。
练武这种事情，牢内的这些狱卒根本没有多少兴趣，练武是多么枯燥的事情？！
枯燥也就算了，还要往里面搭银子！
真有那银子，他们享受了不好么？！
人生苦短，享受为先，为什么一定要苦了自己呢？！
林铭练武的事情，对大家来说，也就仅仅是一个小小的插曲而已！
简单的聊了一下之后，众人该耍钱的耍钱，该吹牛的吹牛，完全没有因为此事，受到过多的影响！

……
林铭也在这里呼喊了一阵子之后，就赶紧前去送饭了，送饭的过程之中，也挑选了今天要吸纳的人选，给他的饭菜之中提前下好了蒙汗药！
这一位的内力实力，倒是颇为不俗！
吸干了他的内力，林铭留下了足足两年的功力！
content_en:
The next day!
Lin Ming went to the jail and the jailer's resting area. Lieutenant Lei, who was on duty today, was leading the clerks to play with money!
Lin Ming didn't play with money, but he still watched the excitement from the sidelines!
"Big!"
"Big!"
Follow them and shout here.
Regardless of whether he can win or not, the atmosphere is definitely going to be aroused!
Lieutenant Lei had a good luck today. He won money in three games in a row. The corners of his mouth raised, and when he scanned the audience, he also noticed Lin Ming beside him!
"Hey! Jailer Lin, are you practicing martial arts?!"
Lin Ming had heard before that Lieutenant Lei had profound attainments in martial arts and was a master in the realm of releasing true energy!
Now I know what I said was true!
Otherwise, how could you tell his true nature at a glance? !
As soon as they heard that Lin Ming had started practicing martial arts, the jailers and clerks around him all looked surprised.
Zhang Wenshu kindly reminded:
"Prisoner Lin, not everyone can practice martial arts! If you don't have a certain amount of money and food, you just throw in the vain silver... With that kind of money, it's better to buy more land and get more wives, and leave more inheritance for future generations. In the future, when you meet your ancestors under Jiuquan, you will have more face, right?!"
"That's right! Jailer Lin, I know you like to listen to storytelling and those chivalrous stories. Just listen to those stories, but don't want to practice martial arts and follow them to do chivalry because of those stories... Let's not say that those stories are all made up, those stories really exist!"
Chen Guanying also agreed.
"You are now mature. If you want to cultivate to such a level of martial arts, you must not only have good martial arts, but also have matching body-refining soups, and other auxiliary things. Each of these requires a huge amount of money. Martial arts is like a bottomless pit! Throwing the money in vain, you can't even hear a sound! In the end, you have wasted time, lost money and food, and have not yet improved your martial arts skills!"
"My lords are right!"
Lin Ming nodded repeatedly and agreed:
"I also know the difficulty of martial arts. I am just a small person, and I don't plan to make any big achievements in martial arts. I just practice for fun. Even if I can't reach the strength of Captain Lei, I can at least strengthen my body. We have lived in the prison for a long time, and it is dark and humid. Our bodies are prone to diseases. Practicing martial arts can at least strengthen ourselves and prolong our lives. Even if I throw in some money for this, I think it is worth it!"
"Warden Lin is right! Martial arts training focuses on strengthening the body, as long as you can achieve your goals!"
Lieutenant Lei also took advantage of the situation and said:
"If you can't achieve success in martial arts, you can't practice martial arts. Don't you have to be so utilitarian?!"
As soon as Lieutenant Lei opened his mouth, the conclusion was sealed!
Regardless of whether other people have other ideas in mind, the leader has spoken, and they naturally have to follow the leader's tone!
"What Lieutenant Lei said is absolutely true. Jailer Lin, practice hard. If you achieve something, you will take us with you?!"
"Yes, which martial art do you practice?! Let's do it together?!"
"Take me one, take me one, I also want to keep fit and live longer!"
Facing these voices, Lin Ming kept smiling and nodded repeatedly.
"My dear colleagues, if you are interested, I will naturally be willing to practice with you. What I practice is the exercises that were tortured from the prisoners. They are sparse and ordinary. If anyone wants it, I can write it down and give you a copy!"
"Give me one when you have time!"
"Yes, give me one when you have time!"
These are just words.
The guards in the prison have little interest in martial arts training. How boring is martial arts training? !
Forget it’s boring, you still have to put money into it!
If they really had that money, wouldn't they enjoy it? !
Life is short, enjoyment comes first, why do you have to suffer yourself? !
Lin Ming’s martial arts trainingLove, to everyone, is just a small episode!
After a brief chat, everyone was able to make money when they should, and brag when they needed to, and they were not affected too much by this matter at all!
…
After Lin Ming also shouted here for a while, he hurriedly went to deliver the food. During the process of delivering the food, he also selected the candidates to be recruited today, and gave him the perspiration medicine in advance!
This person's internal strength is quite impressive!
After draining his inner strength, Lin Ming was left with two full years of skill!
